f_28994C84014D6826.text: Orbital Air found out, ambushed us. Most of my crew and passengers didn't make it out. I escaped to Night City.

f_28994D84014D69D9.text: Now I find mercs. Some of my clients are suits fighting other suits. The rest have a problem with a corp. So do I.

f_28994E84014D6B8C.text: So I read the contracts. People signed for years on a station and never paid off the debt. They were written so nobody could.

f_28994F84014D6D3F.text: I started helping the smugglers who got people out. Inside a year I was running things.

f_28A05E840153A56A.text: No catch. I don't take Orbital Air money. I don't hand people over to a corp.

f_28A05F840153A71D.text: Anything else, we can talk about.

f_28A37F8401561354.text: Getting a person out pays more. Taking a suit out pays the most.

f_28AA4F84015BE072.text: He's paying somebody in Japantown to get them back. It's got nothing to do with you.

f_28AA5084015BE225.text: He's a politician. She got the penthouse and his depository receipts.

f_2B0C06ACBC532673.text: All quiet. Somebody went upstairs and came back down with the politician's depository receipts.
